page.overview:
What is Gate?

The Gates are incredibly vast levels of existence. The exact number of Gates is not known, only that there is a "multiplicity" of them.(: Through the Gates of the Silver Key)

The Ultimate Gate is the final Gate that is absolutely limitless and boundless from the perspective of beings from lesser Gates. It is guarded by 'Umr at-Tawil, an avatar of Yog-Sothoth itself. Past the Ultimate Gate lies the Ultimate Abyss, and is the home of Yog-Sothoth.

Randolph Carter passed all the Gates, including the Ultimate Gate, on his journey to meet the All-in-One, and where he saw his infinite duplicates.
